why_ai: Photographing real people on location and reading them in the moment stays human, though editing and selling are automating and smartphones erode the low end.
why_clarity: A good portrait is partly taste, but picture-day routines repeat and purchases or retakes give feedback within weeks.
why_digital: Sessions start from people in a room or at a venue, editing happens on screen, and clients receive digital galleries plus physical prints from local studios.

why_ai: Someone must photograph every child on site each fall, but the routine is codified and much of the surrounding data and sales work automates.
why_clarity: Highly repetitive sittings with written specifications, and orders and retakes reveal success within weeks.
why_digital: Children photographed in person at the school, with online ordering and printed packages delivered back through the school.

why_ai: On-site capture of every child keeps people at the station, while the deliverables the contract turns on are data work that automates.
why_clarity: District RFPs spell out deliverables and deadlines, and every school repeats the same job.
why_digital: In-person picture day at the school, with rosters, ID files and yearbook packages exchanged digitally.

why_ai: Styled on-location sessions where seniors choose a photographer whose look they like, protected by presence and taste.
why_clarity: Yearbook specifications are exact, but the session product is judged on style and each shoot differs.
why_digital: Shot in person on location, delivered as digital galleries and yearbook files, booked locally and through social media.

why_ai: Couples pay for a specific photographer to be present and anticipate unrepeatable moments at a live event, which AI cannot attend.
why_clarity: The day follows a known sequence and shot list repeated every Saturday, but the look is the photographer's taste and the couple's verdict comes weeks later, once.
why_digital: The work starts from a live event, editing is on screen, delivery is a digital gallery plus albums, and couples book local photographers after meeting them.

why_ai: Teams must be photographed at the field, but the job is routine and any competent sports photographer can do it.
why_clarity: Team and individual shots follow fixed templates repeated across every team, with orders as quick feedback.
why_digital: Players photographed in person at fields, orders often on paper, and printed packages handed out through the league.

why_ai: In-person sittings and portrait sales in the church hall rely on presence and goodwill, while the free printed directory faces digital substitutes.
why_clarity: Standard household portraits repeated over a sitting window, judged by fill rate and sales at the sitting.
why_digital: Families photographed in person, portraits sold face to face, and the product is a printed directory.

why_ai: The work is physical and on site with children, but it is low-skill by design and the checks it lacks are exactly what software can add.
why_clarity: A short, repeated routine with clear technical standards, though the knack for expressions is learned by feel.
why_digital: Children in front of a camera at a school, with frames uploaded for digital ordering and printed packages.

why_ai: Getting a usable photo of an infant or toddler takes patience and presence on site that software cannot supply.
why_clarity: Repeated across centres, but each young child is unpredictable and the good frame is partly luck and taste.
why_digital: Young children photographed in person at the centre, with ordering online and prints sent home.

why_ai: Selection and editing of image files is already being absorbed by AI tools priced at a few dollars a month.
why_clarity: Thousands of near-identical decisions per wedding, judged against the photographer's own taste rather than a fixed rule.
why_digital: Raw files in, edited files out, done entirely on screen and often outsourced abroad.

why_ai: Gallery hosting, reminders and lab routing are software functions with no human advantage.
why_clarity: Orders placed or not, by gallery and product, measured exactly and quickly.
why_digital: Digital galleries and stores online, with prints and albums shipped by labs and sold through local studios.

why_ai: Pricing and forecasting on proprietary order data automate well, but the data itself and the school relationships stay with the company.
why_clarity: Revenue per enrolled child and order counts give exact, fast feedback on pricing and selling-model decisions.
why_digital: Order and capture records analysed on screen for a business sold through in-person school relationships.

why_ai: Software analytics on platform data, readily automated and defended mainly by customer lock-in.
why_clarity: Engagement and order metrics are exact and continuous across many studios.
why_digital: A fully online software business sold remotely to photographers.

why_ai: Model building for image selection and editing is itself the automation, under constant competition from general image models.
why_clarity: Model outputs are checked against photographers' corrections at scale, though taste sets the target.
why_digital: Images and edit histories in, models and software out, sold online worldwide.

why_ai: Internal surveys and segment sizing that AI tools increasingly assist, kept by access to the maker's own registration and dealer data.
why_clarity: Methods are standard, but product bets are judged years later in sales.
why_digital: Survey, registration and sell-through data analysed and reported digitally.

why_ai: Scored as the owners' acquisition work, not picture day: account evaluation happens on screen and in owner meetings (hence low physical), and judging which schools will renew runs on relationships AI does not replace.
why_clarity: Each acquisition is a one-off whose value shows only after a season or two.
why_digital: Account books analysed on screen, but deals are done in person between owners.

why_ai: Printing and binding physical books and serving school advisers in person keeps part of the work human, while page layout automates.
why_clarity: Books are specified by page counts, templates and deadlines and checked in proof.
why_digital: Pages built from digital files, delivered as printed books through local school relationships.

why_ai: Small-team forecasting and survey work that general data tools increasingly substitute, kept by analyst reputation.
why_clarity: Forecasts follow standard methods but are verified only years later, if at all.
why_digital: Surveys and data in, reports and advisory calls out, sold remotely.

why_ai: Certification, competitions and events need human judges and gatherings, while benchmark reporting automates.
why_clarity: Benchmarks follow fixed definitions each cycle; certification follows written standards.
why_digital: Member data and education online, with in-person conventions and competitions.

why_ai: Vendor vetting is paperwork AI can assist, but award decisions carry public accountability and member trust.
why_clarity: Bids are scored against written criteria on regular cycles.
why_digital: Proposals, contracts and awards handled digitally for member districts in a region.

why_ai: Small standard policies priced from tables are readily automated, with licensed agents and adjusters still signing claims.
why_clarity: Rating rules are fixed, but claim outcomes arrive slowly and rarely.
why_digital: Policies quoted, sold and serviced online.

why_ai: Accountable officials must approve vendor data use and enforce the law, and AI raises rather than lowers that demand.
why_clarity: Statutes and contract templates exist, but each vendor review involves judgement and outcomes surface only after an incident.
why_digital: Agreements, reviews and complaints handled digitally by state and district offices.

why_ai: Coaching sells a personal brand photographers trust, though generic business advice is easily substituted by AI.
why_clarity: Advice is personal and its effect on a studio shows slowly and confounded with everything else.
why_digital: Courses and coaching delivered online, with occasional in-person workshops.
